functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION blogpost.reject_immutable_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Immutable snapshot cannot be updated' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
END;
$function$
functions.name: reject_immutable_update
